ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dark-pigmented (low-intensity) and white-pigmented (high-intensity) zones, roughly estimated at a 3:2 ratio of dark to light pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white blobs originate at the peduncle base and extend into the mid-section of both lobes. Low-intensity dark pixels dominate the distal tips and trailing edges, interspersed with high-frequency white pixel mottling and fine linear structures.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 15% of the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular boundary featuring multiple macro-level indentations, including a prominent semi-circular notch on the right lobe trailing edge. High-frequency micro-serrations (1-4 pixel amplitude) are detected along the entire continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-upward sweep from the central notch towards the distal tips; the right lobe trajectory is interrupted by significant structural excisions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-intensity pixel clusters (estimated 3-10 pixel diameter) are visible, particularly concentrated on the dark-pigmented fields of the right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions; includes distinct parallel rake marks on the lower sections of both lobes and numerous unaligned scratches across the central pigmentation zones.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large structural excision (missing tissue) on the trailing edge of the right lobe; widespread white linear scarring (rake marks) and circular scarring throughout the visible ventral area.
other_distinctive_markers: Intricate, filigree-style white pigmentation patterns forming complex geometric lines against the dark background on the superior sections of both lobes.
